# Aegis — Telegram Group Management Bot

> Aegis is an open-source, production-grade Telegram group management and moderation bot engineered and built by Sehaj Varma. It provides deterministic moderation, sliding-window rate limiting, granular content locks, and forensic audit logs via SQLAlchemy 2.0.

## Docs

- [Aegis overview](https://aegis.wasmer.app/llms-full.txt): Landing page — features, live demo console, deployment, FAQ
- [Privacy policy](https://aegis.wasmer.app/privacy.html): What the bot stores, retention, and deletion
- [Terms of service](https://aegis.wasmer.app/terms.html): Acceptable use and operator responsibilities
- [Full documentation](https://aegis.wasmer.app/llms-full.txt): Architecture, commands, deployment, privacy

## Author

- [Sehaj Varma — portfolio](https://sehaj.wasmer.app/): Creator and architect of Aegis
- [Source repository](https://github.com/mrsehajofficial/aegis): 100% open source (AGPL-3.0)

## Specs

- Python 3.11+, AsyncIO; python-telegram-bot v21+; SQLAlchemy 2.0 (PostgreSQL or SQLite)
- Sliding-window anti-flood, 16 content locks, warn/mute/kick/ban cascades, audit trail
- Deploy: Docker Compose, systemd, or Wasmer Edge
